Content: A high-capacity electronics manufacturing facility runs a diagnostic safety scan on a batch of newly produced microprocessors. The quality control database records the following frequencies of surface anomalies across the sample.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T1.json
If `text(one)` microprocessor is selected at random from this batch, what is the probability that the selected microprocessor has no anomalies detected?

A municipal library tracks the `text(daily)` circulation logs of morning book drop-offs to optimize structural shelf sorting. On a `text(Tuesday)` morning, the head librarian records the following categorical sorting frequencies.

:ibox:Biographies / Memoirs: `14`

• Science Fiction / Fantasy: `22`

• Historical Fiction: `9`

• Children's Picture Books: `5`
If a volunteer reaches into the morning drop-off bin and selects a book completely at random, what is the probability that the selected book is categorized as Science Fiction / Fantasy?

A city's department of transportation monitors arrival schedules at a major downtown light-rail transit platform during the morning rush hour. Over a `text(two-week)` tracking window, inspectors log the following arrival frequency metrics for individual trains.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T2.json
Based on these tracking logs, what is the probability that the next train to arrive at the platform will be exactly on schedule?

An academic advisor tracks demographic registration metrics across a university's foundational chemistry lecture block. The registrar's database outputs the following student population breakdown by academic class standing:

:ibox:`text(First-year)` students (Freshmen): `112`

• `text(Second-year)` students (Sophomores): `54`

• `text(Third-year)` students (Juniors): `21`

• `text(Fourth-year)` students (Seniors): `13`
If the professor calls on one student at random to demonstrate a lab simulation, what is the probability that the chosen student is a `text(first-year)` student?

A commercial agricultural greenhouse implants organic heirloom tomato seeds into specialized incubation trays to monitor seed germination viability rates. After a fixed growth window, a horticulturist records the following development statuses across the batch.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T3.json
If one seed position is chosen completely at random from the incubation trays for a nutrient soil test, what is the probability that the selected position holds an unviable seed?

A high school guidance counselor summarizes the enrollment data for twelfth-grade students registered in either a studio art elective or a computer science elective. The two-way frequency table below shows the distribution of these students by their preferred post-graduation track.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T4.json
If a twelfth-grade student who is entering a career technical program is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is enrolled in the studio art elective?

An IT supervisor at a technology firm audits a week of hardware support tickets. The table below displays the breakdown of tickets based on the device type and whether the issue was resolved remotely or required an on-site technician.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T5.json
An audited support ticket is selected at random. Given that the chosen ticket was for a laptop computer, what is the probability that the issue required an on-site technician?

A municipal health department gathers data from a local wellness expo. Participants are categorized by their primary choice of `text(daily)` physical activity and whether they reported sleeping at least `text(7 hours per night)`.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T6.json
If a participant who reported getting less than `text(7 hours)` of sleep is selected at random, what is the probability that their primary physical activity is walking or jogging?

An online marketplace catalog manager evaluates customer return rates during a holiday promotion window. The table organizes returned clothing items by category and whether they were reported as defective.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T7.json
A returned item is selected at random from this database tracking pool. Given that the selected item is a top/shirt, what is the probability that it has a manufacturing defect?

A community botanical nursery evaluates the success rates of organic vegetable starters. The horticulturist cross-references seedling varieties with their verified survival outcomes after a minor seasonal frost window.
:table:guides/SAT-M/PSDA/checks/supps/PS-TFP-T8.json
A seedling from this testing block is selected at random. Given that the seedling is a sweet pepper plant, what is the probability that it survived the frost window?
